general_information.Description: This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the entire customs process and practice in international trade. It is suitable for anyone who needs to know more about the processes involved in getting your goods through customs smoothly and efficiently. AI Tools will be used to support students in (1) generating ideas/structures for their speaking notes and slide structure of important topics of the course. (2) editing the slide set after students have already finished it.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Tools: - Laptop computer - Internet - Class room for lecture sessions

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To explain the concept and practice of customs procedures
To get insight into globlization, import & export, Incoterm 2010, 2020
To understand customs surveillance and control
To summerize and interpret State management on customs
To identify risk management on customs operations.
To evaluate the development of customs internationally and in Vietnam
To apply the understanding of customs procedures into customs declaration and taxation
To practice the professional attitude and skills of achieving understanding of customs operation in international business

constructive_questions.Details: On May 15th 2021, Meyer Company signed contract number 7403202 with Casio company, Japan. Imported goods: Casio electronic organ. Quantity: 185 PCE; Unit price: 171 USD/PCE FOB Arimura- Japan. Commercial value: 31,635 USD; Shipping fee to Vietnam: 500 USD; Exchange rate USD/VND= 20,879.; Imported tax: 7%; Value Added tax 10%. Calculate the taxable amount of the Meyer company.

constructive_questions.Name: CT8.1
constructive_questions.Details: On Oct 10th 2020, Saigon Production and Commercial Company signed an import contract with Vin Company, France. Imported goods: wine; quantity: 1.500 PCE; unit price 72 USD/PCE CIF CatLai – Hochiminh City; Method payment: L/C. Commercial value: 108,000 USD; Shipping fee to Vietnam: 3.500 USD;Exchange rate: USD/VND= 21,135; Special preferential Imported tax: 50%; Value Added tax 10%; Excise tax: 25%. Calculate the taxable amount of this company.

constructive_questions.Name: CT8.2
constructive_questions.Details: On Sep 15th 2019, Thanh Phu Company signed contract number TP.19.14 with Ananbond Company, India. Imported goods: polyetylen bag; quantity: 10.500 kgs; unit price 4 USD/kg FOB Delhi – India. Commercial value: 42,000 USD; Shipping fee to Vietnam: 4,500 USD; Insurance fee: 2,500 USD; Exchange rate: USD/VND = 21.450; Imported tax: 15%; Environment protection tax: 40000 dong/kg; Value Added tax 10%. Calculate the taxable amount of this company.
